purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: HM Land Registry publishes monthly INSPIRE Index Polygons as a free OGL GML dataset, partitioned by local authority; the current 2026-09-06 listing names Sheffield City Council and provides a ZIP containing the GML. The polygons cover freehold registered property only, are indicative extents, and each has a documented Land Registry INSPIRE ID. The public archive was not downloaded or spatially filtered during this packet pass, so no feature geometry or point hit is verified; this does not imply geometry is absent.
registryAssessment: HM Land Registry’s current authority-partition listing includes Sheffield City Council. Official guidance describes free monthly GML INSPIRE downloads under OGL, with a unique INSPIRE identifier per polygon; these are indicative freehold registered-property extents only.
